Featuring multiple well-formed, transparent to translucent points emerging from a common base, this eye-catching specimen is ideal for any mineral collector or as a one-of-a-kind display accent in your home or office. The surfaces reveal subtle internal inclusions, sparkling faces, and a hint of natural earthy matrix along the underside, highlighting its organic origins.
The cluster's sculptural arrangement provides visual interest from every angle, making it a versatile decor piece that can serve as a focal point in a collection, on a shelf, or as a unique conversation starter. Quartz is appreciated for both its clarity and its durability, ensuring this specimen will remain striking for years to come.
